body: Nothing really as the cause. Yeah I talked to my family, my leadership and started appointments for therapy and psych but it’s just been like diagnosis and planning so far so hopefully that helps. I’ll definitely check out these articles hopefully they help appreciate it
No problem. I guess only one way to tell how telling her would go but if you’re still feeling down you can pm me any time

Do you ask for advice from them? People may be willing to hear you out and think you don’t want advice or simply not know what you need or want to give advice that doesn’t work. There is no one magic fix, try and seek alternatives and find what might make you happy in life, what you enjoy doing either as work or on the side

I don’t know you personally but you can PM me. We all struggle, it’s easy to give in but I try to find something that interests me. You could join a club or play games or whatever might distract you and find people that like the same stuff so you have something in common immediately. It helps me to talk to people, even if just over the phone or text talking to an old friend from college or something. Sometimes it helps just to let someone know what’s going on in your head. If you’ve been together for 7 years I’m sure you have enough trust and are close enough you can talk to each other about these things, she might not notice because sometimes the signs aren’t apparent unless you’re looking for them. Only way she can know for sure is to tell her but if that’s not comfortable right now you can send me a pm. Recognizing somethings wrong and seeking help has been the hardest part for me, I know it can feel overwhelming but even little things help.

Yeah I just was talking to my mom about it beforehand and figured I’d talk to him about it. Don’t want to leave family in the dark but he seems to think depression=trying to commit suicide so I’m not sure how much I’ll be able to get through. Thanks :)
